claim: Evaluated payment vendors against tokenization requirements, with limiting PCI-DSS scope as an evaluation objective.
limitations: The claim describes vendor evaluation criteria and an intended scope objective; it does not establish a compliance determination, validated scope reduction, certification, or elimination of PCI-DSS responsibilities.
No vendor identity, payment or customer data, proprietary requirement, control design, selection result, audit finding, or quantified outcome is disclosed.
title: Evaluate payment tokenization requirements
